read.title: Re: Damaged Goods in Order #4471
read.text:
Dear Mr. Haddad,

We sincerely apologize for the damaged toner bottles in order #4471. Thank you for sending the photos so quickly.

Our logistics team is investigating the cause. It appears that the pallets were not wrapped properly at the port.

As compensation, we will issue a credit note for the 240 damaged bottles, which will be deducted from your next invoice. We will also use stronger outer cartons from the next shipment.

Please let us know if this solution works for you.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

Dear Ms. Lopez,

We sincerely apologize for the leaking serum bottles in your last shipment. Our quality team is investigating the cause now. We will issue a credit note for the 150 affected units, and we will check the caps more carefully from now on.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
